purpose: Replace the bracket-only generated balcony divider cue with a physically assembled ordinary balcony separation panel before bevel and Danchi LOD generation. The source gate awards zero Visual Fidelity points until native Unity pixels are reviewed.

manufactureInstallation.assembly: Thin calcium-silicate/fibre-cement-like board captured inside an anodized-aluminium perimeter frame, with the existing front low/high divider brackets retained and two rear wall brackets plus discrete fasteners added as mounting interfaces.
installationSequence: Seat the perimeter frame 60 mm above the persisted generated balcony slab top so the board is neither buried in the slab nor painted onto the facade.
Run the panel depth from the facade-side rear frame toward the existing front divider brackets without crossing the front railing plane.
Capture the 6 mm board inside the frame with 32 mm frame members and a deliberate inset from every edge.
Retain the existing front low/high divider brackets as the front attachment context; add separate rear wall brackets and fasteners so the panel has two-sided support rather than a floating sheet.
Build the source assembly before the authored-mesh bevel pass; the existing Danchi LOD generator then derives LOD0/1/2 treatment from the physical source hierarchy.

materialPhysicalModel.specularModel: dielectric Unity Standard response; approximately ordinary dielectric F0, never metallic
materialPhysicalModel.microstructure: low-amplitude isotropic mineral/fibre surface breakup generated into tangent-space normal; no directional light signal and no painted edge highlight
materialPhysicalModel.uvAging: dry midsummer UV/chalking may slightly broaden roughness and lower chroma; it must not create glossy wet sheen
materialPhysicalModel.angularFresnelResponse: grazing brightness must arise from the realtime sun/sky/reflection solution and dielectric Fresnel response, not albedo paint

interfacesGapsSeals: board edge is inset 32 mm behind the perimeter frame on all four sides
frame bottom is 60 mm above slab top; no slab interpenetration is permitted
front frame remains behind the railing plane and spatially meets the existing divider-bracket zone
rear frame sits at the facade-side endpoint and receives two explicit wall brackets with fastener heads
no panel component may overlap the neighbouring window opening or AC assembly

orientationExposureAging.orientation: vertical YZ partition at the left boundary of each generated balcony bay
orientationExposureAging.exposure: outer faces receive midsummer UV, wind-driven rain and airborne dust; framed edges and bracket recesses retain more grime
orientationExposureAging.aging: cause-based UV chalking, rain wash and interface dirt only; no arbitrary damage, impact, emergency narrative or baked streak lighting

geometry: rear wall brackets and fastener heads

lodPolicy.lod0: complete board, perimeter frame, rear brackets and fastener heads
lodPolicy.lod1: board/frame plus rear brackets; fastener heads may be removed as sub-pixel hardware
lodPolicy.lod2: board and perimeter frame remain to preserve balcony depth/occlusion; rear brackets may be removed
lodPolicy.lod3: panel may be omitted only under the existing 0.03-to-0.008 screen-relative cross-fade regime; actual temporal evidence must reject any visible topology pop or shimmer

lookdev.frontal: Show a readable but restrained off-white mineral panel between balcony bays; verify board/frame silhouette and no primitive-placeholder reading.
lookdev.oblique: Reveal the real 6 mm board thickness, 32 mm frame depth, 60 mm floor clearance, rear wall bracket and existing front bracket relationship.
lookdev.grazing: Verify broad rough dielectric response on the board versus narrower anodized-aluminium frame response; no painted highlight is allowed.
lookdev.crop100Percent: Inspect board/frame inset, rear bracket/fastener contact, front bracket relationship, z-fighting, floating gaps, bevel response and micro-normal stability.
lookdev.temporal: Inspect the LOD2-to-LOD3 cross-fade for a visible partition disappearance, shimmer or aliasing; any visible pop remains an automatic Visual Fidelity failure.

failureInjection: Delete one panel core and require formal pre-cull failure.
Move one panel below the slab-clearance datum and require failure.
Set board metallic above zero tolerance and require failure.
Remove the generated board normal or metallic/smoothness map and require failure.
Compress either physical-data texture, enable sRGB, disable mipmaps, reduce anisotropy below 8 or enable a Standalone override and require failure.
Delete one rear wall bracket or its fasteners and require failure.
Disable a panel/frame source renderer and require failure.
Remove the panel/frame from the expected LOD0/1/2 assignments and require failure.
